feature_queries.name: author_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.Author_ID,
  e.date,
  LENGTH(a.Name) AS name_len
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.Author_ID = e.Author_ID

feature_queries.name: calendar
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  Author_ID,
  date,
  EXTRACT(year FROM date) AS year,
  EXTRACT(month FROM date) AS month,
  EXTRACT(doy FROM date) AS day_of_year
FROM eval_table

feature_queries.name: pub_history_dense
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT Author_ID, date FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  b.Author_ID,
  b.date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Paper_ID) AS pubs_all_time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.Submission_Date >= b.date - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN pa.Paper_ID END) AS pubs_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.Submission_Date >= b.date - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN pa.Paper_ID END) AS pubs_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.Submission_Date >= b.date - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN pa.Paper_ID END) AS pubs_180d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.Submission_Date >= b.date - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN pa.Paper_ID END) AS pubs_365d,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(pa.Submission_Date), b.date) AS days_since_last_pub
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN paperAuthors pa
  ON pa.Author_ID=b.Author_ID
 AND pa.Submission_Date < b.date
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: coauthor_dense
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT Author_ID, date FROM eval_table), my_papers AS (
  SELECT b.Author_ID, b.date, pa.Paper_ID
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN paperAuthors pa
    ON pa.Author_ID=b.Author_ID
   AND pa.Submission_Date < b.date
), coauthors AS (
  SELECT mp.Author_ID, mp.date, pa2.Author_ID AS coauthor_id
  FROM my_papers mp
  JOIN paperAuthors pa2 ON pa2.Paper_ID = mp.Paper_ID
)
SELECT
  b.Author_ID,
  b.date,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT co.coauthor_id) - 1, 0) AS coauthor_count_all_time
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN coauthors co ON co.Author_ID=b.Author_ID AND co.date=b.date
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: citation_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.Author_ID, e.date
  FROM eval_table e
), my_papers AS (
  SELECT
    b.Author_ID,
    b.date,
    pa.Paper_ID
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN paperAuthors pa
    ON pa.Author_ID = b.Author_ID
   AND pa.Submission_Date < b.date
), refs AS (
  SELECT
    mp.Author_ID,
    mp.date,
    c.References_Paper_ID
  FROM my_papers mp
  JOIN citations c
    ON c.Paper_ID = mp.Paper_ID
   AND c.Submission_Date < mp.date
)
SELECT
  Author_ID,
  date,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*),0) AS n_references_made
FROM refs
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: y_lags2
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT Author_ID, date FROM eval_table), joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.Author_ID,
    b.date,
    t.date AS hist_date,
    t.publication_count
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN train_table t
    ON t.Author_ID=b.Author_ID
   AND t.date < b.date
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Author_ID,
    date,
    hist_date,
    publication_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Author_ID, date ORDER BY hist_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  Author_ID,
  date,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN publication_count END), 0) AS y_lag_1,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN publication_count END), 0) AS y_lag_2,
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rn<=4 THEN publication_count END), 0) AS y_avg_last_4,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN publication_count END),0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN publication_count END),0) AS y_trend_1m2,
  (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN publication_count END),0) + 1.0) / (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN publication_count END),0) + 1.0) AS y_ratio_1m2,
  COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN hist_date END), date), 99999) AS days_since_last_y
FROM ranked
GROUP BY 1,2
